fusions.name: Plate Biter
fusions.desc: A quick chop that deals 5 damage and leaves the target 6% easier to wound for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Bell-Struck
fusions.desc: Rings the flat of the blade off your own plate, dealing 11 resonating damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles and stunning them for 1.2 seconds.

fusions.name: Haft Guard
fusions.desc: Raises a barrier that absorbs the next 20 damage and holds for 6 seconds, and raises your armour by 10% while it holds.

fusions.name: Seam Finder
fusions.desc: Your physical attacks ignore 15% of the target's armour.
